title: Reading Drill — Stopping wind at an open café — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Stopping wind at an open café — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Millcross began with reports of napkins blowing from outdoor tables. The café operator had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using reset counts and chose items lost per busy hour as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was weighted trays. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted six weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded differences in table size as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
